# API Contracts Checklist: Cypher Query Access

**Purpose**: Validate that SPEC-013 API, CLI, MCP, grammar, result, diagnostic, and parity requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable before task generation.
**Created**: 2026-07-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist api-contracts` command based on feature context and requirements.

- [x] CHK004 Are predicate, null, string predicate, and opaque JSON/array field requirements defined for both accepted and rejected `WHERE` usage? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-012, Spec §FR-013, Contract §Predicate Semantics]
- [x] CHK005 Are projection, alias, scalar, typed value, count, grouping, ordering, limit, cap, truncation, and no-`totalRows` contracts all specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, Spec §FR-018, Spec §FR-019, Spec §FR-020, Data Model §Result Model]
- [x] CHK006 Are every public surface and entry point named, including `queryCypher`, `codegraph query`, `codegraph search`, and `codegraph_query`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-025, Spec §FR-028, Spec §FR-031, Contract §Exported Package Surface, Contract §CLI Routing, Contract §MCP Tool]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK016 Are MCP default-listing requirements consistent with retrieval guardrails that keep `codegraph_explore` primary? [Consistency, Spec §FR-028, Spec §FR-030, Plan §PR Strategy, Constitution §VI]

## Notes

- Initial run found one API-contract gap: malformed UTF-8 stdin was listed as an edge case but did not have a stable diagnostic contract. Remediation added `CYPHER_INVALID_STDIN_ENCODING` behavior to `spec.md`, `contracts/cli-mcp-parity.md`, and `data-model.md`.
- Re-run result: no gap markers remain in the API Contracts checklist domain.
